summary: Squirrel compiler state for one function being compiled (SQCompiler derived from Script_Function / SQFuncState): tracks local-variable records, captured outer values, child function states and the compile-error hook; created by Script_SqCompiler_Compile.
evidence: Script_Compiler_CreateFunction (0x001BE0B4) allocates 0xF4 bytes and calls Script_Function_Init(obj, sharedState, self, self->0xEC, self->0xF0); Script_Compiler_DeclareLocal (0x001BD588) appends 0x14-byte SQLocalVarInfo records to the vector at +4 and SQOuterVar records to the vector at +0x54.

fields.name: localVarInfoCapacity
fields.evidence: Capacity of the 0x14-byte local-variable record vector whose data pointer is at +4; Script_Compiler_PushLocalVar doubles it with 0x0014CE14 when the record count at +8 reaches it.

fields.name: maxStackDepth
fields.evidence: High-water mark of the local-slot count at +8: PushLocalVar raises it to the current count and reports internal compiler error: too many locals above 0xFF (Squirrel MAX_FUNC_STACKSIZE).

fields.name: outerValueArray
fields.evidence: Pointer to 0x14-byte SQOuterVar records ({type u8, name SQObjectPtr, src SQObjectPtr}); Script_Compiler_DeclareLocal appends kind 0/1/2 entries when a name resolves in the parent function state at +0xA8.

fields.name: outerValueCount
fields.evidence: Number of 0x14-byte outer-variable records in outerValueArray; incremented after every append in Script_Compiler_DeclareLocal.

fields.name: outerValueCapacity
fields.evidence: Capacity of outerValueArray; doubled through 0x0014CE14 when full in Script_Compiler_DeclareLocal.

fields.name: parentFuncState
fields.evidence: Parent Script_Function (SQFuncState) searched by Script_Compiler_DeclareLocal for outer locals; Script_Function_Init stores its parent argument here.

fields.name: childFuncStateArray
fields.evidence: Pointer to the array of 0xF4-byte child Script_Function states created by Script_Compiler_CreateFunction and destroyed by Script_Compiler_FreeLastFunction.

fields.name: childFuncStateCount
fields.evidence: Number of live child function states in childFuncStateArray; incremented by CreateFunction and decremented by FreeLastFunction.

fields.name: childFuncStateCapacity
fields.evidence: Capacity of childFuncStateArray; doubled in Script_Compiler_CreateFunction when the count reaches it.

fields.name: errorHandler
fields.evidence: Compiler error callback (CompilerErrorFunc); invoked as errorHandler(errorContext, string) from PushLocalVar for internal compiler error: too many locals.

fields.name: errorContext
fields.evidence: Opaque first argument passed to errorHandler; Script_Function_Init stores the compiler fifth argument here (the error context).

summary: Reference-counted Squirrel container value block: Sq_Container_ReleaseAll drops its five inline value slots, two dynamic value arrays and a 0x30-byte entry block, then unregisters it from the owner at +0x8C.
evidence: Sq_Container_ReleaseAll (0x005B553C) guards on bit 0x80000000 at +4, calls the Squirrel value-release helper on +0x38/+0x40/+0x48/+0x50/+0x58, loops the 8-byte arrays at +0x18/+0x1C and +0x24/+0x28, and releases +8 of each 0x30-byte entry at +0x60.

fields.name: valueArray
fields.evidence: Base of the first dynamic array of 8-byte Squirrel values; ReleaseAll calls the value-release helper for each of valueCount(+0x1C) entries.

fields.name: valueCount
fields.evidence: Number of 8-byte entries in valueArray(+0x18); the ReleaseAll loop bound.

fields.name: maybe_secondaryValueArray
fields.evidence: Base of a second dynamic array of 8-byte Squirrel values, released element by element by Sq_Container_ReleaseAll; its role (keys or parallel values) is unknown.

fields.name: secondaryValueCount
fields.evidence: Number of 8-byte entries in the second value array at +0x24; the ReleaseAll loop bound.

fields.name: maybe_valueSlot0
fields.evidence: Start of an 8-byte Squirrel value (type tag here, payload at +4) released by Sq_Container_ReleaseAll; the member's purpose is not visible in the one recovered function.

fields.name: maybe_valueSlot1
fields.evidence: Second 8-byte Squirrel value released by Sq_Container_ReleaseAll; purpose unknown.

fields.name: maybe_valueSlot2
fields.evidence: Third 8-byte Squirrel value released by Sq_Container_ReleaseAll; purpose unknown.

fields.name: maybe_valueSlot3
fields.evidence: Fourth 8-byte Squirrel value released by Sq_Container_ReleaseAll; purpose unknown.

fields.name: maybe_valueSlot4
fields.evidence: Fifth 8-byte Squirrel value released by Sq_Container_ReleaseAll; purpose unknown.

fields.name: entryArray
fields.evidence: Array of 0x30-byte entries; ReleaseAll releases the Squirrel value at entry+8 for each entry, with the count read at +0x64.

fields.name: ownerVm
fields.evidence: Owner whose +0x48 object-registry list is unlinked from this object in Sq_Container_ReleaseAll (0x00245C40); the same +0x48 registry is used by Sq_Array_Create.

summary: Squirrel function-compiler state (SQFuncState) seen through its vector members: live local-variable records, the integer slot stack, the literal/value stack and the finalized local-variable info list.
evidence: Script_ObjectVector_Push (0x001BD258) appends an 8-byte SQObjectPtr to the vector at +0x48; Pop (0x001BE454) reads a slot index from the u32 stack at +0x10/+0x14 and pops the 0x14-byte record at +4; Trim (0x001BD3FC) moves live records from +4 into +0x6C with end_op = instruction count (+0x64) - 1.

fields.name: localVarCapacity
fields.evidence: Capacity of the 0x14-byte local-variable record vector at +4; doubled with 0x0014CE14 whenever the count at +8 reaches it (PushLocalVar / PushCounted).

fields.name: intSlotStack
fields.evidence: Array of u32 slot indices; Script_ObjectVector_Pop reads the index as intSlotStack[intSlotCount-1].

fields.name: intSlotCount
fields.evidence: Number of u32 entries in intSlotStack(+0x10); Pop decrements it after reading the top index.

fields.name: maxStackDepth
fields.evidence: High-water mark of the local-variable record count at +8; PushCounted raises it when the count grows (Squirrel MAX_FUNC_STACKSIZE tracking).

fields.name: literalStack
fields.evidence: Base of an 8-byte SQObjectPtr vector; Script_ObjectVector_Push appends interned strings produced by Script_FuncState_CreateString during Script_SqCompiler_Compile (literal/constant pool).

fields.name: literalCount
fields.evidence: Number of 8-byte entries in literalStack(+0x48); incremented by Push after the copy.

fields.name: literalCapacity
fields.evidence: Capacity of literalStack; doubled with 0x0014CE14 when literalCount reaches it (Push).

fields.name: maybe_localVarInfoArray
fields.evidence: Second vector of 0x14-byte local-variable records; Trim moves still-live records here from +4 and sets their end_op from the instruction count (+0x64) minus one.

fields.name: maybe_localVarInfoCount
fields.evidence: Number of 0x14-byte records in the vector at +0x6C; incremented by Trim when a live record is moved.

fields.name: maybe_localVarInfoCapacity
fields.evidence: Capacity of the vector at +0x6C; doubled with 0x0014CE14 when the record count reaches it (Trim).

summary: Event/script-trigger state that the Script_Native_* gameplay bindings operate on: it holds the trigger-record array, a re-entrancy index, an abort flag and the script callback object.
evidence: In Script_Native_ATrgMapJumpEvent (0x00251230) the 0x18-byte trigger records delimited by +0x98/+0x9C are walked, the loop index is published through +0x6C, the callable at +0x70 is passed to Script_InvokeScriptCallback, and the +0x3D8 byte aborts the walk.

fields.name: currentRecordIndex
fields.evidence: Saved, set to the current trigger-record index and restored around each Script_InvokeScriptCallback call, so the script sees which record is being processed (re-entrancy guard).

fields.name: maybe_scriptCallback
fields.evidence: Address param_1+0x70 is passed as the callable/self argument to Script_InvokeScriptCallback (0x00579B64); likely the event callback object, but only its address is used here.

fields.name: triggerRecordArray
fields.evidence: Base of an array of 0x18-byte trigger records; ATrgMapJumpEvent skips records whose first byte is zero and reads the id at record+4.

fields.name: triggerRecordArrayEnd
fields.evidence: End pointer of triggerRecordArray; (end - start) / 0x18 gives the record count in the ATrgMapJumpEvent loop.

fields.name: maybe_isProcessing
fields.evidence: When non-zero, ATrgMapJumpEvent returns 0 without doing any work; when zero it performs the map-jump trigger pass, so it looks like an already-processing / disabled guard.

fields.name: abortRequested
fields.evidence: Cleared before the trigger loop and tested every iteration; Script_InvokeScriptCallback can set it to stop the remaining trigger records (checked in the while condition).

fields.name: maybe_scriptContext
fields.evidence: Pointer to a polymorphic script object whose vtable slot +0x08 is called with a local SQObjectPtr before and after the trigger loop (looks like acquiring/releasing a script context).

summary: TCS (talk/cutscene) jump script context: validates that a cutscene scene and frame exist, releases the animated model instance, then seeks the scene and reports success.
evidence: maybe_Script_TCSJump_Check (0x003978F4) gates on +0x10/+0x14/+0x2C, resolves a frame through maybe_Script_TCS_FindSceneFrame, bounds-checks the index against the u16 count in (*(+0x158)+0x60)+0xC, and calls the Anim_ModelInstance_Release region on self+0x14C.

fields.name: maybe_scriptOwner
fields.evidence: Non-null gate in Script_TCSJump_Check before any cutscene lookup; never dereferenced in the recovered body, so its concrete type is unknown.

fields.name: maybe_isActive
fields.evidence: Must be non-zero together with +0x10 and +0x2C before the TCS jump lookup runs (byte read in Script_TCSJump_Check).

fields.name: scene
fields.evidence: Pointer to the TCS scene searched by maybe_Script_TCS_FindSceneFrame: the frame table is (scene+0x60) and the 0xC-stride entry offset array is at scene+0x64.

fields.name: maybe_modelAnimInstance
fields.evidence: Address self+0x14C is passed to the Anim_ModelInstance_Release code region (0x005AD368) once the jump is accepted, so this is an inline animated-model instance (only its first word is recorded in this batch).

fields.name: frameScene
fields.evidence: Required non-null before the jump; dereferenced to +0x60, whose u16 at +0xC bounds-checks the frame index resolved by FindSceneFrame.

fields.name: maybe_sceneFrame
fields.evidence: Non-null companion of frameScene in Script_TCSJump_Check; only tested for null, so its concrete role (current frame entry) is inferred from proximity.

summary: Squirrel SQFuncState line-info vector: AddLineInfos appends {line, instructionIndex} pairs and remembers the last emitted line so repeated lines are deduplicated.
evidence: maybe_Script_RecordVector_AddUnique (0x001BD1A4) matches Squirrel SQFuncState::AddLineInfos: it compares _lastline (+0xD0), appends an 8-byte {line, opIndex} pair to the vector at +0x9C (count +0xA0, capacity +0xA4) and stores the line back to +0xD0.

fields.name: lineInfoArray
fields.evidence: Base of the 8-byte line-info records; AddLineInfos writes {line, instructionIndex} at lineInfoArray[lineInfoCount].

fields.name: lineInfoCount
fields.evidence: Number of 8-byte line-info records in lineInfoArray; incremented after the append in AddLineInfos.

fields.name: lineInfoCapacity
fields.evidence: Capacity of lineInfoArray; doubled with 0x0014CE14 when the count reaches it (AddLineInfos).

fields.name: lastLine
fields.evidence: Last source line for which a line-info record was emitted; AddLineInfos skips the append when it equals the requested line and force is zero, then updates it.

summary: Squirrel array object: an 8-byte SQObjectPtr value vector plus the VM registration link; Sq_Array_Create allocates it and Sq_Array_AppendRange grows it.
evidence: Sq_Array_AppendRange (0x005F9EF4) grows the 8-byte element vector at +0x18 (count +0x1C, capacity +0x20) with 0x0014CE14 and copies elements from the source array; Sq_Array_Create (0x005F9D8C) allocates 0x24 bytes and registers the array in the VM list at vm+0x48.

fields.name: valueArray
fields.evidence: Base of the 8-byte SQObjectPtr element array; AppendRange and Script_Array_Reverse index it with element*8.

fields.name: valueCount
fields.evidence: Number of 8-byte elements in valueArray(+0x18); AppendRange and Reverse use it as the array length.

fields.name: valueCapacity
fields.evidence: Capacity of valueArray; AppendRange doubles it with 0x0014CE14 when valueCount reaches it.

fields.name: maybe_vmObjectList
fields.evidence: VM+0x48 list head passed to 0x00245C1C when Sq_Array_Create registers the new array; the batch records it against the array because Create's self argument is the VM, not the array.

summary: Squirrel closure/thread wrapper object: it starts with a vtable, owns a VM child object that its destructor releases, and carries the VM stack-base index used to locate arguments.
evidence: Script_Closure_Destroy (0x00576720) writes vtable DAT_00576764 at +0, and when the byte at +0x10 is set calls 0x006BD10C(self+0x4, self+0x8) and 0x006BD12C(self+0x8) to release the embedded VM child; Script_Closure_BindEnv (0x006BAA68) adds +0x34 to an argument index before Sq_VmGetStackSlot.

fields.name: vtable
fields.evidence: Script_Closure_Destroy writes DAT_00576764 (vtable 0x00782690) at offset 0.

fields.name: ownerVm
fields.evidence: First argument to 0x006BD10C when the destructor releases the child object at +0x8; looks like the VM/shared state that owns the child.

fields.name: stackBase
fields.evidence: Added to (argumentIndex - 1) before Sq_VmGetStackSlot in Script_Closure_BindEnv, i.e. the current call's VM stack base; the batch attributes this VM field to Script_Closure because BindEnv's self argument is typed as the closure.

summary: Growable u32 vector used by the script compiler; Push doubles the capacity through 0x0014CE14.
evidence: Script_IntVector_Push (0x001BCE5C) appends a u32 to the array at +0x10, increments the count at +0x14 and doubles the capacity at +0x18 with 0x0014CE14 when the count reaches it.

fields.name: data
fields.evidence: Base of the u32 element array reallocated by Script_IntVector_Push.

fields.name: count
fields.evidence: Number of u32 elements; Push stores at data+count*4 and increments it.

fields.name: capacity
fields.evidence: Capacity of data; Push doubles it when count >= capacity.

summary: TCS (talk/cutscene) script context used by GetTCSSceneFrame: it gates on three handles and searches the current scene's 0xC-stride frame table by name.
evidence: maybe_Script_TCS_FindSceneFrame (0x00397F88) requires +0x10, +0x14 and +0x2C to be non-null/non-zero, then walks the entries of (*(+0x2C)+0x60) (u16 count at +0xC, 0xC-stride offsets at +0x64) comparing each entry name.

fields.name: maybe_scriptOwner
fields.evidence: Non-null precondition in FindSceneFrame; never dereferenced there, so the concrete owner type is unknown.

fields.name: maybe_isActive
fields.evidence: Must be non-zero along with +0x10 and +0x2C before the scene-frame lookup runs.

fields.name: scene
fields.evidence: Pointer to the TCS scene: its +0x60 frame table has a u16 entry count at +0xC and its +0x64 array holds 0xC-stride offsets used to locate each entry name.

summary: Minimal growable vector header {data, count, capacity} shared by the Squirrel VM helpers; the element width depends on the caller (8-byte script objects, 4-byte u32 or 16-byte object pairs).
evidence: Sq_Vector_PushObject (0x00710A28) and Sq_Vector_PushU32 (0x00710DA8) both test data[2] <= data[1], double the capacity with 0x0014CE14 and store at data[0]+data[1]*width; Sq_Vector_ResizeObjectPairs (0x00710B24) uses the same header with a 16-byte pair stride.

fields.name: data
fields.evidence: Base pointer reallocated by all three Sq_Vector methods (written as *param_1).

fields.name: count
fields.evidence: Element count: Push writes at data[0]+data[1]*stride and then increments data[1].

fields.name: capacity
fields.evidence: Capacity: the vector grows when data[2] <= data[1] and stores the doubled value back to data[2].

summary: Squirrel VM stack window used by Script_Array_Reverse: +0x30 is the evaluation-stack top and +0x34 the current call's stack base, so their difference is the available argument count.
evidence: Script_Array_Reverse (0x006BA944) raises not enough params in the stack when *(int*)(+0x30) - *(int*)(+0x34) < 1, then fetches the requested argument through Script_CheckArgType.

fields.name: stackTop
fields.evidence: Evaluation-stack top: Script_Array_Reverse subtracts the stack base from it to count the arguments passed to the native call.

fields.name: stackBase
fields.evidence: Base index of the current call's stack window; added to an argument index to address a slot and subtracted from stackTop(+0x30) to count arguments.

summary: Squirrel SQObjectPtr: an 8-byte tagged value (type/refcount tag at +0, payload reference at +4) copied by Script_ObjectPtr_Assign and reset by Script_ObjectPtr_Clear.
evidence: Script_ObjectPtr_Assign (0x001BF7D8) copies the tag from +0 and the payload from +4, bumps the payload refcount when the tag has bit 0x08000000, and releases the old payload; Script_ObjectPtr_Clear (0x001BC734) releases and nulls the payload.

fields.name: type
fields.evidence: SQObject type tag; bit 0x08000000 marks a refcounted payload (checked before incrementing/decrementing the payload refcount in Assign).

fields.name: value
fields.evidence: Payload pointer/reference; what the tag in type describes. Assign copies it and AdjustRefCount-style code bumps payload[1].

summary: Squirrel array iterator delegate: NextIndex validates the integer index, compares it with the container size and returns the next (index, element) pair from the byte array at +0x1C.
evidence: Script_Iterator_NextIndex (0x006110DC) accepts only an integer script value, returns -1 when the index is not below containerSize(+0x14), and otherwise reads element byte self+0x1C+index and writes (index+1, element) to the output values.

fields.name: containerSize
fields.evidence: Iterator bound: NextIndex stops (returns -1) once the current index is not below it, and the iterated byte array starts at self+0x1C.
